## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant issue.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. For visual changes, include rendered before/after evidence and the inspected frame numbers.

## Compatibility

Note public API, project storage, or dependency changes, if any.

- [ ] Relevant checks pass.
